key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:528C
name: select_step_sequence_by_state
description: Branches on a shared state variable (values 1 and 2 plus a default) and on a flag argument, storing fixed constants into that variable and calling the same routine recursively, and resets the variable to zero when it passes a per-branch limit.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:52C8
name: run_fixed_step_then_reset
description: Stores a fixed constant in the shared state variable and calls an unnamed routine, then resets it to zero and calls again if it exceeds 2.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:52FE
name: select_step_by_register_pair
description: Chooses between two constant sequences based on a second register argument equal to 2 and a flag argument, storing each constant in the shared variable and calling an unnamed routine, with a reset once a limit is passed.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5322
name: run_negative_step_then_reset
description: Stores a negative fixed constant in the shared variable and calls an unnamed routine, then resets it to zero and calls again if it exceeds 3.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5358
name: select_step_by_flag
description: Stores a negative constant or a positive constant in the shared variable depending on the flag argument, calls an unnamed routine, and in the positive branch resets the variable to zero and calls again once it exceeds 4.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5374
name: run_step_then_reset
description: Stores a fixed constant in the shared variable, calls an unnamed routine, and resets the variable to zero with a second call if it exceeds 4.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:53AE
name: relay_single_routine_call
description: Contains only one call to an unnamed routine followed by a return, passing control on with no state change of its own.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:53D8
name: store_constant_then_call_twice
description: Stores a fixed constant in the shared state variable and then calls an unnamed routine twice in succession before returning.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5428
name: call_routine_twice
description: Calls an unnamed routine two times in a row and returns; the decompiled body contains nothing else.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:545C
name: mask_value_or_forward
description: ORs the incoming register value with 223, which forces every bit except bit 5 on; if the shared state variable is nonzero it returns the result of an unnamed routine instead.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:54A6
name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times in succession and returns, with no other logic in the decompiled body.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:54B4
name: advance_counter_and_copy_planes
description: Increments a shared counter while it stays below 10, then copies 16 scanlines of four bitplanes into each of 12 rows, taking rows before the counter from one source block and the remaining rows from the alternate block.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:54DC
name: copy_plane_rows_by_counter
description: Copies 16 scanlines of four bitplanes into each of 12 row destinations without changing the counter, taking rows before the shared counter from one source block and the remaining rows from the alternate block.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5568
name: increment_shared_counter
description: Adds one to the shared state variable and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5572
name: add_bcd_then_call_six
description: Adds 3 to a shared state variable, applies a decimal (BCD) adjustment to it, then calls an unnamed routine six times in succession.

description: Adds the three low-order bytes of a register argument into a shared variable, applying decimal (BCD) adjustment after each addition, then calls an unnamed routine seven times.

name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times in succession and returns, with no other logic in the decompiled body.

name: call_routine_twice

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:57D8
name: call_pair_in_compare_loop
description: Loops calling an unnamed routine twice per pass, but the loop condition compares the shared variable with itself, so the decompiled exit condition is degenerate and the true iteration count cannot be read from this code.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:57EA
name: call_pair_in_compare_loop
description: Loops calling an unnamed routine twice per pass, but the loop condition compares the shared variable with itself, so the decompiled exit condition is degenerate and the true iteration count cannot be read from this code.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:5802
name: copy_twelve_rows_four_planes
description: Copies 12 scanlines of four bitplanes from a source block whose start is a register offset plus a fixed constant, advancing the source and destination by 40 bytes per row and by 8000 bytes between planes.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:82B8
name: cycle_state_and_place_cells
description: Advances a shared state through a four-entry table cycle and, when the state holds a particular value, aligns it and calls an unnamed routine; then steps through grid positions from a table-selected start, storing x and y and calling an unnamed routine for each cell, with x up to 256 and y up to 200.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8300
name: align_cycle_and_place_cells
description: Aligns a register argument down to a multiple of 8 and calls an unnamed routine, then advances a four-entry table cycle and steps through grid positions from a table-selected start, storing x and y and calling an unnamed routine for each cell until x reaches 256 or y reaches 200.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8324
name: cycle_and_place_grid_cells
description: Advances a shared state through a four-entry table cycle, then steps through grid positions starting from a register argument, storing x and y and calling an unnamed routine for each cell until x reaches 256 or y reaches 200.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:835C
name: step_grid_cells_within_bounds
description: Walks a grid of cell positions starting from the register arguments, storing the horizontal position in one fixed memory location and the vertical position in another and calling an unnamed routine for each cell; horizontal stops at 256 and vertical at 200, advancing 16 and 8 respectively.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8390
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8392
name: dispatch_records_for_all_rows
description: Scans a table of 19-word records from its start until a negative first word, and for each record with bit 0 set, bit 1 clear and a third word equal to the current row, calls one of two unnamed routines chosen by bit 10; it repeats this for every row from 16 down to 0.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:83CC
name: scan_table_until_counter_expires
description: Repeatedly scans the same 19-word record table, calling an unnamed routine at each pass and decrementing a stack-held counter at each end-of-table marker; it returns when the counter underflows, and matching records are dispatched to one of two unnamed routines by bit 10.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:83D8
name: dispatch_records_from_row
description: Walks the 19-word record table once for each row index from the register argument down to 0, calling one of two unnamed routines for each record that matches that row with bit 0 set and bit 1 clear, selected by bit 10.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:83DE
name: step_field_nine_then_restore
description: Saves a word at offset 8 of the structure addressed by the address register, then runs nine passes that each call an unnamed routine and add 16 to that word, and finally writes the saved value back.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:83FE
name: position_clip_and_blit_sprite
description: Computes a sprite's screen position from its record fields and a shared offset, or reuses the stored values when bit 6 of the flag word is set, then clips it to the screen and blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift by calling unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:842A
name: position_and_blit_sprite_record
description: Computes a sprite's screen position from the fields of the record it is given, clips it to the screen, and blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift, storing the computed position back into the record.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8458
name: blit_sprite_from_stored_position
description: Reads the sprite's previously stored position and clip fields from its record, clips it to the screen, and blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift without recomputing the position.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8482
name: blit_sprite_at_given_position
description: Clips a sprite placed by argument registers against the screen bounds and returns immediately when it lies fully outside; otherwise it blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift through an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:848C
name: blit_clipped_sprite_from_registers
description: Clips a sprite placed by argument registers against the screen bounds, adjusting its origin for negative coordinates, then blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:849E
name: blit_sprite_with_top_clip
description: Returns early when the row offset covers the whole sprite height; otherwise it advances the source by the row offset and blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift from the argument registers.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:84AA
name: blit_sprite_with_x_clip
description: Rejects a sprite whose horizontal position is past the screen edge unless a flag bit is set, then blits four bitplanes using the argument registers for origin, width and row offset, with optional masking and a sub-byte shift.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:84BC
name: blit_sprite_with_row_offset
description: Returns early when the row offset covers the full sprite height; otherwise it moves the source pointer by the row offset and blits four bitplanes with optional masking and a sub-byte shift.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:84C4
name: blit_sprite_select_shift_kernel
description: Selects and runs a blit kernel for a sprite according to its sub-byte shift and mask flags, calling unnamed routines per row group after computing the screen destination from the argument registers.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8538
name: blit_shifted_plane_words
description: Shifts source plane words by a sub-byte amount taken from an argument register, combining neighboring words across four bitplanes, and writes them to the destination with optional masking, row by row.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:854E
name: copy_planes_through_mask
description: Copies four bitplanes of source words into the destination row by row; where the fourth source plane is fully set it stores the three plane words and writes all ones into the fourth destination plane, otherwise it merges the words into the destination.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8578
name: apply_plane_color_masks
description: Merges per-plane constant patterns into four bitplane rows of the destination using AND masks and OR values, advancing the destination by the row stride after each row.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:85A4
name: blit_bytes_into_aligned_planes
description: Writes source bytes into four byte-aligned bitplanes of the destination, combining plane bytes from neighboring offsets with AND and OR masks, looping over rows and advancing by the row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8616
name: blit_shifted_words_with_mask
description: Shifts source plane words by a sub-byte amount and merges them into the destination's four bitplanes under masks, running row by row and advancing by the row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:869A
name: blit_shift_wrapped_plane_words
description: Shifts source plane words by a sub-byte amount using the complementary shift count, carrying bits between neighboring words, and merges them into four bitplanes row by row.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8722
name: copy_four_planes_from_offset
description: Copies four bitplane words per row from a source block that starts at a fixed offset, advancing the destination by the row stride, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8734
name: copy_planes_with_small_offset
description: Copies four bitplane words per row from a source block starting a short distance past its base, advancing by the row stride, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8760
name: apply_plane_masks_when_partial
description: Skips rows whose mask word is all ones; otherwise it ANDs each of the four bitplanes with the mask and ORs in a per-plane pattern word, advancing by the row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8792
name: blit_bytes_with_plane_flags
description: Tests flag bits 4 and 10 to choose a byte-level variant, then for each row ANDs or ORs source bytes into four byte-aligned bitplanes and advances by the row stride, calling unnamed routines in some cases.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:880C
name: blit_shifted_words_with_fill
description: Shifts source plane words by a sub-byte amount from an argument register, filling vacated bits with ones, and writes them into four bitplanes row by row under masks.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:888E
name: blit_shifted_words_wrapped
description: Shifts source plane words by the complement of a sub-byte amount, filling vacated bits with ones and carrying bits from the next word, then merges them into four bitplanes row by row.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8914
name: call_library_function_minus_36
description: Calls two unnamed routines and then a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable, then returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8932
name: call_library_function_minus_36
description: Calls two unnamed routines and then a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable, then returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8950
name: call_six_then_library_36
description: Calls an unnamed routine six times, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:899C
name: unpack_run_length_stream
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times, then decodes a word stream into a shared destination: words with high byte 178 are control words, a set bit 7 ends the block, and a count of 8 stops the stream, while other control words repeat the following word count plus one times.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:89AC
name: call_five_then_library_36
description: Calls an unnamed routine five times, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:89EE
name: call_three_then_library_36
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8A10
name: call_three_then_library_36
description: Calls an unnamed routine three times, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the library base held in a global variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8A32
name: set_state_one_and_unpack
description: Sets a shared state variable to 1, calls unnamed routines, then decodes a run-length word stream into the shared destination using the same control-word scheme as the unpacker.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8A5A
name: set_state_two_and_unpack
description: Sets a shared state variable to 2, calls unnamed routines, then decodes a run-length word stream into the shared destination using the same control-word scheme as the unpacker.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8A82
name: set_state_three_and_unpack
description: Sets a shared state variable to 3, calls unnamed routines, then decodes a run-length word stream into the shared destination using the same control-word scheme as the unpacker.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8AAA
name: unpack_stream_with_library_calls
description: Decodes a run-length word stream into the shared destination with the same control-word scheme, and makes calls through the library base held in a global variable at fixed offsets.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8AF8
name: fill_then_decode_run_stream
description: Fills the destination with a source word repeated a count held in an argument register, then decodes a run-length word stream with the same control-word scheme, stopping when a count of 8 ends it.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B04
name: decode_run_stream_with_seed
description: Writes an argument word to the destination, then decodes a run-length word stream from the source with the same control-word scheme, returning when a count of 8 ends it.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B08
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B0C
name: init_four_audio_channels
description: Programs all four audio channels with a fixed start location, a length of 16 words, a period of 400 and zero volume, then sets a shared state variable and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B7A
name: set_state_one_then_loop
description: Sets a shared state variable to 1 and calls an unnamed routine, then enters a loop whose exit condition is not visible in the decompiled output.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B90
name: disable_audio_interrupts
description: Sets a shared state variable through the values 5 and 1, writes a mask of four audio interrupt bits to the interrupt enable register with the set bit clear to disable them, and then sets the state to 15.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8B9C
name: disable_audio_interrupts_if_idle
description: When the shared state variable is zero, sets it through 8 and 1, clears the four audio interrupt enable bits through the interrupt enable register, and sets the state to 15; otherwise it returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8BB2
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8BB4
name: disable_audio_interrupts
description: Sets a shared state variable through the values 3 and 1, clears the four audio interrupt enable bits through the interrupt enable register, and sets the state to 15.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8BC0
name: disable_audio_interrupts
description: Sets a shared state variable through the values 2 and 1, clears the four audio interrupt enable bits through the interrupt enable register, and sets the state to 15.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:8BC8
name: disable_audio_interrupts
description: Sets a shared state variable to 1, clears the four audio interrupt enable bits through the interrupt enable register, and sets the state to 15.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:90C8
name: store_argument_then_call_five
description: Stores a register argument in a shared state variable, then calls an unnamed routine five times.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:90EA
name: allocate_memory_and_open_libraries
description: Clears a block of memory, finds the current task and allocates memory through the exec library, marks a field of the new allocation with all ones, opens a library and stores its base in a shared variable, then offsets a shared pointer into the allocation by fixed amounts.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:919A
name: install_interrupt_server
description: Calls the exec library's AddIntServer through the library base to install an interrupt handler, then enters a loop; the decompiled body shows only that call and the loop start.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:91F8
name: setup_display_and_copper_list
description: Counts down a long delay, then writes display window, data-fetch, bitplane control and modulo registers, points the copper at its list through the copper location register, restarts it through the copper jump register, and updates DMA and interrupt enable bits.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:92C0
name: build_bitplane_pointer_table
description: Writes four bitplane addresses, each 8000 bytes past the previous, as low and high word pairs into a table, then copies sixteen source words shifted left by one bit into a shared table.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9308
name: call_four_then_return
description: Calls four unnamed routines in succession, some of which reach library functions through a base pointer, and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9332
name: retry_library_call_with_delay
description: Repeatedly calls a library function with an argument and a fixed code while the result is zero; each failed attempt calls another library function, advances a shared value by 256, calls an unnamed routine and busy-waits for a long count.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9382
name: store_argument_in_state
description: Stores its register argument in a shared state variable and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:938E
name: retry_library_call_or_fallback
description: Calls a library function through the library base; a nonzero result is stored in a shared variable before returning, while a zero result calls through a stored code pointer and enters a loop.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:93EC
name: call_stored_pointer_and_loop
description: Calls the code address held in a shared variable and then enters a loop; the decompiled body shows no further logic.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:93F6
name: advance_state_and_dispatch
description: Advances a shared counter, wrapping it to zero when it reaches 1, calls through that variable's value as a code address, then calls three unnamed routines and sets the variable to 1.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:95FA
name: clear_four_state_fields
description: Sets four shared state fields to zero and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9618
name: decode_stick_direction_bits
description: Reads shared input state and builds direction bits for the stick position, returning early when a previous flag is set, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:962E
name: decode_button_state_bits
description: Combines shared input flags into a small button-state value through conditional branches, then calls two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9640
name: combine_input_flag_bits
description: Builds a bit pattern from shared input flags by setting bit values 8, 4, 2 and 1 according to conditional branches, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9652
name: select_input_bit_pattern
description: Chooses the input bit pattern from shared flags by OR-ing bit values 8, 2 and 1 under conditional branches, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9672
name: add_flags_with_high_bit
description: Adds bit value 2 and a high-order flag bit to the input pattern when the shared flags match, clears the state when the pattern is empty, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:96B6
name: map_first_axis_to_bits
description: Maps a signed shared axis value to direction bits: below minus one it sets bit values 4 and 1, above one it sets bit value 8, and it then calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:96D0
name: map_second_axis_to_bits
description: Maps a second shared axis value to direction bits, setting bit value 8 when a register argument exceeds one and bit values 1 or 2 from the shared value, and sets a high-order flag when the shared value is nonzero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:96F6
name: store_direction_bits_offset
description: Stores the combined direction bits in a shared variable and, when the stored value is negative, adds 10 to it.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:973A
name: clamp_stick_offset_ten
description: Subtracts 10 from a register argument with clamping at zero, then adds 10 back to negative results and clamps again, storing the outcome in a shared variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:976A
name: subtract_ten_clamped_at_zero
description: Subtracts 10 from a register argument, stores the result in a shared variable and clamps negative results to zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:977E
name: decode_joystick_port_direction
description: Reads the joystick port movement register and decodes its direction bits into a shared state value, combining them with a fire flag, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:97B8
name: decode_movement_register_bits
description: Combines bits of a movement register argument into a direction value, setting bit values 2 and 1 from the register pattern, and tests a shared flag before storing the result.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:97DC
name: store_fire_button_bits
description: Sets a fire-button bit from the parallel input register and stores the combined bits in a shared variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9802
name: read_fire_button_delta
description: Reads the fire-button bit from the parallel input register, computes a signed difference from the previous sample, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:981C
name: read_pot_button_delta
description: Reads the right and middle button bits from the pot register, computes a signed difference from the previous sample, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9846
name: read_mouse_axis_delta
description: Reads the mouse-port movement register into a signed difference from the previous sample, clamps it against a shared range, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9892
name: clamp_and_store_position
description: Raises a register value to at least a shared minimum and stores it in a shared variable, then clamps a difference against a second register value.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:98C4
name: raise_to_shared_minimum
description: Raises a register value to a shared minimum, stores it in a shared variable and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:98DC
name: set_state_minus_one
description: Stores minus one in a shared variable and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:98E6
name: stub_empty_loop_return
description: Contains only a loop header followed by a return, so the decompiled body shows no visible work; it appears to be a stub or a wait whose condition is not decoded.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:98F4
name: store_nibble_and_flag
description: Stores the low four bits of a register argument in a shared variable unless it already matches, then sets or clears bit value 64 according to bit 0 and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9904
name: store_value_with_flag_bit
description: Stores a register argument in a shared variable, then sets or clears bit value 64 according to its bit 0.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9926
name: set_or_clear_bitmap_bit
description: Clears the bit selected by the low three bits of a register argument in a shared byte, or sets it when bit value 2 of a second argument is set.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:994A
name: set_or_clear_bitmap_bit
description: Clears the bit selected by the low three bits of a register argument in a shared byte, or sets it when bit value 4 of a second argument is set.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:996E
name: set_or_clear_bitmap_bit
description: Clears the bit selected by the low three bits of a register argument in a shared byte, or sets it when bit value 8 of a second argument is set.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9992
name: clear_bitmap_bit
description: Clears the bit selected by the low three bits of a register argument in a shared byte and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:99A0
name: clear_pixel_bit_in_planes
description: Computes a byte address from row and column arguments, then clears the selected pixel bit in each bitplane and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:99E2
name: clear_bit_across_four_planes
description: Clears the bit selected by the low three bits of a register argument in the byte at the address register in each of four bitplanes.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:99F2
name: fill_rows_from_low_memory
description: Calls four unnamed routines, then reads four longwords from low system memory and fills a block of memory with that pattern across 200 passes.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9A06
name: fill_block_from_low_memory
description: Reads four longwords from low system memory and fills a block of memory with that pattern across 200 passes, without calling any routine first.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9A4A
name: relay_single_routine_call
description: Contains only one call to an unnamed routine followed by a return, passing control on with no state change of its own.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9A62
name: copy_eight_bytes_to_buffer
description: Copies eight entries from the source pointer in the address register into a shared buffer, advancing both pointers on each step.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9A74
name: shift_eight_entries_in_buffer
description: Copies eight entries from one position in a shared buffer to a second position, advancing both pointers in a single loop.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9AE4
name: relay_single_routine_call
description: Contains only one call to an unnamed routine followed by a return, passing control on with no state change of its own.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9B24
name: wait_for_blitter_then_call
description: Calls unnamed routines and waits in a loop while the blitter busy bit is set in the DMA control read register, then calls another unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9B66
name: start_blitter_copy_setup
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then loads source and destination pointers, row modulo values, first and last word masks, control bits chosen from a shift argument, and the blit size to start a copy.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9BC2
name: call_library_then_forbid
description: Calls a library function through the library base, then calls the exec library's Forbid, and returns a register pair.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9BDE
name: call_library_then_permit
description: Calls a library function through the library base, then calls the exec library's Permit, and returns a register pair.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9BFA
name: clear_two_plane_blocks
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then zeroes two blocks of entries across four bitplanes, with ten passes per block.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9C5C
name: clear_rows_across_four_planes
description: Clears 24 rows of words across four bitplanes at a fixed offset from the shared base pointer.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9C84
name: set_state_fields_to_four
description: Sets shared state variables to 1, 0 and 4 in turn and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9CB2
name: set_state_fields_to_eight
description: Sets shared state variables to 0 and 8 in turn and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9CE0
name: set_fields_to_minus_eight
description: Sets shared state variables to 0 and minus 8 in turn and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9D0E
name: compute_row_offset_mod_192
description: Stores a register argument in a shared variable, takes its remainder modulo 192 and the distance to the next multiple of 192, and stores a 16-aligned offset derived from it, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9D18
name: double_and_flag_state
description: Doubles a shared value when it is nonzero and, when its sign bit is set, stores 2, 1 and 0 in sequence, calling two unnamed routines along the way.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9D56
name: clear_state_field
description: Sets a shared variable to zero and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9D60
name: compute_row_offset_wrap
description: Stores a register argument, reduces it modulo 192 with a branch for the remainder, derives a 16-aligned offset from the result, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9DBE
name: compute_table_offset_entry
description: Stores a fixed value of 256 and a table entry selected by a register index in shared variables, then stores a position computed from the arguments scaled by 56.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9DEC
name: call_if_flags_set
description: Calls an unnamed routine when a shared variable is nonzero, repeats the call under a second check of the same variable, then returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9E6A
name: wait_for_blitter_then_call
description: Calls unnamed routines and waits in a loop while the blitter busy bit is set in the DMA control read register, then calls another unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9EAC
name: start_blitter_copy_wide
description: Waits for the blitter to become idle, then sets pointers, masks, control bits and blit size for a copy that uses different source and destination row modulo values.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9F14
name: compute_screen_byte_offset
description: Stores two register arguments in shared variables and computes a byte offset from the first argument plus the second multiplied by 320, storing the result in a shared variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9F3E
name: copy_glyph_rows_to_screen
description: Copies eight bytes from a table entry selected by a register argument into successive rows of the destination, advancing by the 40-byte row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9F7E
name: advance_index_scaled_offset
description: Calls unnamed routines, then increments a shared index and recomputes it as a scaled byte offset by summing shifted copies of itself, giving a multiplier of 322.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9F98
name: advance_index_scaled_offset
description: Calls unnamed routines, then increments a shared index and recomputes it as a scaled byte offset by summing shifted copies of itself, giving a multiplier of 322.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9FA2
name: map_char_to_glyph_index
description: Maps a character code in a register argument to a glyph index by subtracting 32, 64 or 96 according to the 32-code range it falls in, starting from codes above 31, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9FAC
name: map_char_to_glyph_index
description: Maps a character code in a register argument to a glyph index by subtracting 32, 64 or 96 according to the 32-code range it falls in, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9FCA
name: subtract_64_from_code
description: Returns the register argument minus 64.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9FD8
name: subtract_32_from_code
description: Returns the register argument minus 32.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:9FE8
name: copy_eight_rows_four_planes
description: Copies eight rows of four bitplane words from the source to the destination, advancing both by the 40-byte row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A012
name: merge_masked_rows_four_planes
description: Merges eight rows of four bitplanes from the source into the destination under a mask taken from the fourth source plane, advancing by the row stride.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A056
name: set_palette_entry
description: Writes its second argument into the hardware colour register selected by the index in its first argument, starting from COLOR00.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A064
name: clear_low_memory_words
description: Zeroes a block of words starting at low memory address zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A07E
name: find_first_inactive_record
description: Walks a table of 19-word records, skipping those with bit 0 set, until it finds one with that bit clear, and returns if the table ends with a negative terminator; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine on the record it found.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A0A2
name: copy_record_into_free_slot
description: Advances a destination pointer through a table of 19-word records until it reaches a negative terminator, then copies the 19-word source record into the slot it found.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A0B0
name: call_flagged_record_handlers
description: Walks the 19-word record table until a negative terminator, calling the code pointer stored in each record that has bit value 32 set, then returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A0D4
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A116
name: initialize_record_from_offsets
description: Stores sums of a source record's fields and register offsets into a destination record, clamping one value into the range 0 to 16, and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A134
name: store_clamped_record_field
description: Clamps a register argument to a maximum of 16, stores it in a record field, then walks the 19-word record table until a negative terminator and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A180
name: store_sprite_fields_with_state
description: Sets a shared state value to 1, calls an unnamed routine, stores two register arguments into record fields, then clears the state.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A1A6
name: store_pair_fields_clear_state
description: Calls an unnamed routine, sets a shared state flag to 1, stores two register arguments into record fields, then clears the flag.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A1DA
name: store_pair_into_record_fields
description: Calls an unnamed routine and stores two register arguments into record fields.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A1F2
name: start_audio_channel
description: Selects one of four audio channels from the argument, sets its bit in the ADKCON register, enables its interrupt through INTENA, records its state in a shared table, and sets its period register to 200.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A252
name: call_unless_flag_set
description: Returns immediately when a shared variable is nonzero; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and returns its register pair.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A2E0
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A2E2
name: call_unless_flag_set
description: Returns immediately when a shared variable is nonzero; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and returns its register pair.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A31E
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A320
name: call_and_forward_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and keeps its returned value, then calls another unnamed routine with it, with a branch on a shared variable.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A384
name: call_unless_flag_set
description: Returns immediately when a shared variable is nonzero; otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and returns its register pair.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A390
name: call_then_return_pair
description: Calls an unnamed routine and returns the register pair it leaves behind.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A3A8
name: scan_range_table_for_match
description: Scans a table of three-byte range entries from a fixed start until a sentinel address, comparing a shared value against each entry's bounds and calling unnamed routines for matches.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A3E8
name: init_entry_and_copy_block
description: Unless the entry pointer is the sentinel, sets three bytes of the entry to a shared value, then copies a block of 24 words from the argument record and calls unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A3F6
name: walk_range_entries_until_sentinel
description: Walks range entries from the argument pointer until the sentinel address, calling unnamed routines for each entry.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A41A
name: scan_ranges_clear_on_sentinel
description: Compares a shared value against range entries and, at the sentinel address, sets the shared value to zero and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A41C
name: clear_state_field
description: Sets a shared variable to zero and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A428
name: init_entry_and_copy_block
description: Sets three bytes of the entry to a shared value, then copies a block of 24 words from the argument record and calls an unnamed routine.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A46E
name: set_dash_and_call_five
description: Stores the character with code 45 at a fixed field of the argument record, points a shared pointer past it, and calls unnamed routines five times.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A4D6
name: write_digit_character
description: Writes the ASCII digit for a register value to the buffer pointer, using the zero digit when the value is zero and a width argument is nonzero, and writes nothing when both are zero.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A4EA
name: write_zero_character_if_set
description: Writes the ASCII zero character to the buffer pointer when the width argument is nonzero, and returns.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A4FA
name: copy_header_then_block
description: Copies three header words from the source record into the destination fields, then copies a block of 26 words from the argument record.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A51C
name: fill_name_buffer_with_marks
description: Writes an underscore fill mark into a shared text buffer, fills the following 13 positions with dot marks, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A52A
name: fill_text_buffer_with_dots
description: Writes an underscore at position 3 of a shared text buffer, fills 13 following positions with dot marks, and calls four unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A5A2
name: store_char_and_pad_row
description: Stores a character argument at a row offset, advances a shared index and fills the rest of the 15-position row with underscore marks, calling two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A5C8
name: replace_fill_marks_with_spaces
description: Scans 14 characters of a text buffer, replacing underscore marks with spaces and handling dot marks separately, and calls two unnamed routines.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A606
name: call_library_then_store_result
description: Calls a library function through the library base; when it returns a nonzero value it stores that value in a shared variable, calls an unnamed routine, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the base.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A63E
name: stub_immediate_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so calling it does nothing; the decompiled body is empty.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A640
name: call_library_then_store_result
description: Calls a library function through the library base; when it returns a nonzero value it stores that value in a shared variable, calls an unnamed routine, then calls a library function at a fixed offset of 36 bytes before the base.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A676
name: poll_candidates_with_limit
description: Runs up to 20000 passes over candidate addresses starting from a fixed address, testing each with an unnamed routine and returning the first result that passes.

key: Star Wars - Return of the Jedi/Star Wars - Return of the Jedi.adf:jedi:0:A6A4
name: scan_string_for_terminator
description: Scans bytes from the address register with a loop that stops on the zero flag, storing the current position in a shared pointer and clearing it when a count argument is zero, and calls two unnamed routines.
